purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; abstract vocabulary (いかに/限ら/応じ/重視/認める) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 物事を、いかに見るかが大切です。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一つの答えに、限られますか?
lines.en: Is it limited to one answer?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいえ、一つに限らず、複数あります。
lines.en: No, not limited to one — there are several.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 状況に応じて、変わるんですか?
lines.en: Does it change according to the situation?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、状況に応じて、答えは変わります。
lines.en: Yes, the answer changes according to the situation.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 何を、重視すべきですか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自分の弱さを認めることを、重視します。
lines.en: We emphasize acknowledging our own weakness.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 認める勇気が、いかに大事か分かりました。
lines.en: I see how important the courage to acknowledge is.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
